Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Library of Congress/HAER information and asserted that Charles A. Allen was the city engineer of Springfield, despite the search snippet clearly stating he was the city engineer of Worcester. This misattribution led the Planner to infer the wrong county seat (Springfield → Hampden County) instead of Worcester (Worcester County), steering the solution toward the incorrect county and causing subsequent confusion.
